- \( 8^8 = (2^3)^8 = 2^{24} \)
- \( 12^{12} = (2^2 \times 3)^{12} = 2^{24} \times 3^{12} \)

The LCM of \( 6^6 \), \( 8^8 \), and \( k \) must be \( 2^{24} \times 3^{12} \). For \( k \), we consider its prime factors. Since the LCM cannot introduce new primes, \( k \) must be of the form \( 2^a \times 3^b \).
